note: FOOTPRINT polygons are real: position, outline, orientation and area come from the source and are not modified beyond a documented simplification. HEIGHTS are NOT surveyed except where src="p". src="p" is a published architectural height matched to this footprint by proximity; src="m" is a storey count read from Microsoft's DSM height below 18 m; src="d" is derived from footprint area and distance to a district core by the model in scripts/bake-buildings.mjs#derivedStoreys. The DSM height field saturates near 35 m (Columbia Center, 284 m, reads 25.1 m) and is discarded above 18 m rather than rescaled.
